blogPosts.title: EV Charger Installation Cost in Nunawading & Melbourne's East (2026 Guide)
blogPosts.excerpt: A complete guide to EV charger installation costs in Nunawading and Melbourne's eastern suburbs. Learn about charger types, labour, switchboard requirements and government rebates in 2026.
body: Installing an EV charger at your Nunawading home is one of the smartest investments you can make in 2026, but understanding the true cost before you commit is essential. In Melbourne's eastern suburbs, the total price for a home EV charger installation typically ranges from $1,200 to $3,500 depending on your electrical setup, charger type and installation complexity. At Millar Electrics, we've completed hundreds of EV charger installations across Nunawading, Box Hill, Doncaster and surrounds since 2020. This guide breaks down every cost factor so you can budget with confidence and avoid overpaying for your home charging setup.

The first cost factor is your choice of charger unit. A single-phase 7kW home charger suitable for most Nunawading residences costs between $800 and $1,500 for the unit itself, while a faster three-phase 22kW unit runs $1,800 to $3,000. Tesla Wall Connectors, Zappi chargers and OCPP-compatible units are popular choices across Melbourne's eastern suburbs. If your home has solar panels, a smart charger with load management like the Myenergi Zappi can maximise your solar self-consumption — a significant advantage given Melbourne's rising electricity rates in 2026.

Installation labour in the Nunawading area typically adds $400 to $1,200 to your total cost. This covers the licensed electrician's time for mounting the unit, running the circuit from your switchboard, installing any required safety switches and completing the final testing and certification. Homes in older Box Hill or Doncaster properties may require a switchboard upgrade first, which adds $600 to $1,000 but is critical for safety and compliance with Australian Standard AS/NZS 3000. At Millar Electrics, we always provide a fixed written quote before commencing any EV charger work.

One factor many Nunawading homeowners overlook is the distance between your switchboard and the charger location. If your garage is on the opposite side of the house, additional cabling costs of $200 to $500 may apply. Underground conduit runs through driveways or garden beds also add complexity and expense. Our team at Millar Electrics always conducts a thorough on-site assessment before quoting, so there are no surprises on installation day. We service homes across Nunawading, Blackburn, Ringwood, Templestowe and surrounding eastern suburbs with the same careful approach.

Victoria's rebate landscape for EV chargers has evolved significantly in recent years. The Victorian Government's Zero Emissions Vehicle subsidy and the federal EV Discount may reduce your upfront costs. As of early 2026, eligible Nunawading residents can access up to $2,000 in combined incentives when purchasing a new EV and installing a home charger. Millar Electrics stays across all current rebate programs and can guide you through the application process as part of our end-to-end EV charger installation service across Melbourne's eastern suburbs.

If you're considering an EV charger installation in Nunawading, Box Hill, Doncaster or anywhere in Melbourne's eastern suburbs, the team at Millar Electrics is ready to help. We provide free on-site assessments, fixed written quotes and a lifetime workmanship guarantee on every installation. Our licensed electricians handle everything from switchboard upgrades to final certification, ensuring your setup meets all Australian safety standards. Call us on 0421 237 773 or email david@millarelectrics.com.au to book your free EV charger consultation today.

blogPosts.title: Home Rewiring in Melbourne's Eastern Suburbs: When, Why & How Much It Costs
blogPosts.excerpt: Is your Nunawading or eastern suburbs home overdue for a rewire? Discover the warning signs, costs, process and Australian safety standards for home rewiring.
body: If you live in an older home across Nunawading, Box Hill, Doncaster or Melbourne's eastern suburbs, there is a good chance your wiring is overdue for a safety check. Many homes in the area were built between the 1960s and 1980s with aluminium wiring or undersized circuits that simply weren't designed for modern power demands. A full home rewiring by a licensed electrician in Melbourne's east typically costs between $4,000 and $15,000 depending on home size, access and the extent of the work required. Understanding when and why to rewire can protect your family and your property.

The most common reason Nunawading homeowners contact Millar Electrics for a rewire is safety concerns. Outdated wiring is one of the leading causes of house fires in Victoria each year. Symptoms like flickering lights, buzzing outlets, frequently tripping breakers or discoloured power points are red flags that your wiring may be deteriorating dangerously. We conduct thermographic inspections alongside visual assessments to pinpoint hidden faults behind walls and ceilings — something a standard inspection simply cannot detect. Catching these issues early can save thousands in emergency repairs and potentially save lives.

During a full home rewire, our licensed electricians replace all internal wiring from the switchboard to every power point, light fitting and hardwired appliance throughout your property. In Nunawading homes, this typically takes three to five days depending on the property size and access. We install new TPS thermoplastic sheathed cable to current Australian standards, upgrade your switchboard with modern safety switches known as RCDs on every circuit, and ensure full compliance with AS/NZS 3000 Wiring Rules. Our team carefully minimises disruption to your household throughout the entire process.

The cost of a home rewire in Melbourne's eastern suburbs varies based on several key factors. A standard three-bedroom Nunawading home with accessible roof and subfloor spaces will cost less than a double-storey Blackburn property with limited access. Additional costs may include switchboard upgrades ranging from $600 to $1,000, plaster repairs if wall channels are required at $200 to $500 per room, and any additional circuits for new appliances or renovations. At Millar Electrics, we provide itemised written quotes so you know exactly what you are paying for before we start any work.

Many homeowners in Box Hill and Doncaster are also choosing to rewire as part of a larger renovation or sale preparation strategy. A certified rewire adds significant value to your property and provides buyers with documented proof that the electrical system meets current Australian standards. Our team at Millar Electrics works closely with builders and real estate agents across the eastern suburbs to schedule rewiring at the right stage of a project. We also provide a full compliance certificate upon completion, giving you complete documentation for insurance or sale purposes.

If your Nunawading or eastern suburbs home hasn't had its wiring checked in over 20 years, it is time to book an assessment with Millar Electrics. Our licensed electricians will inspect your complete electrical system using thermographic technology and provide a detailed report with honest recommendations. We never recommend unnecessary work — just straightforward advice based on safety and compliance requirements. Call 0421 237 773 or email david@millarelectrics.com.au to schedule your home wiring inspection across Melbourne's eastern suburbs today.

blogPosts.title: Thermographic Electrical Inspections: Preventing Fires in Melbourne's East
blogPosts.excerpt: Thermographic electrical inspections use infrared imaging to detect hidden faults before they cause fires. Learn why Nunawading homeowners and businesses need thermal inspections.
body: Electrical fires are one of the most preventable causes of property damage in Victoria, yet many homeowners across Nunawading, Box Hill and Doncaster have never had their electrical system professionally inspected using modern technology. Thermographic inspection uses advanced infrared imaging to detect hotspots, overloaded circuits and failing connections that are completely invisible to the naked eye. At Millar Electrics, we have been conducting thermographic electrical inspections across Melbourne's eastern suburbs since 2017, identifying potentially dangerous faults before they escalate into costly emergencies or devastating house fires.

A thermographic inspection works by capturing detailed infrared images of your entire electrical system while it is under normal operating load conditions. Excessive heat at any connection point, circuit breaker or cable junction indicates a problem that could lead to arcing, insulation failure or fire ignition. In older Nunawading homes where wiring may date back several decades, these hidden faults are surprisingly common and genuinely dangerous. Unlike a basic visual inspection, thermography reveals what is happening behind switchboard covers, inside wall cavities and at hard-to-reach junction boxes throughout your property.

The Victorian Building Authority recommends thermographic inspections for residential properties over 15 years old, and many insurance companies now require documented electrical inspections for policies on older Melbourne eastern suburbs homes. In Nunawading and surrounding suburbs, homes built between the 1960s and 1990s are particularly at risk due to aging wiring insulation, outdated switchboards and circuits that have been modified over decades without proper certification. A thermographic inspection costs between $300 and $600 for a standard Nunawading home and can potentially prevent catastrophic damage.

Our thermographic inspection process at Millar Electrics is thorough and completely non-invasive. We inspect your main switchboard, all sub-boards, every power and lighting circuit, hard-wired appliances like ovens and air conditioning units, and any external electrical installations around your property. The inspection takes two to three hours for a standard Nunawading home and produces a comprehensive report with thermal images, temperature readings and prioritised recommendations. We provide the same detailed service for commercial properties across Box Hill, Doncaster, Ringwood and the broader Melbourne eastern suburbs.

Common faults we discover during thermographic inspections across the eastern suburbs include loose neutral connections that cause voltage fluctuations and safety risks, overloaded power circuits running at dangerously high temperatures, deteriorating cable insulation hidden inside wall cavities, and aging switchboard components that no longer meet current Australian safety standards. Each of these conditions carries a genuine fire risk if left unaddressed for any length of time. The good news is that most thermographic findings can be resolved quickly and cost-effectively by our licensed electricians, often on the same day as the inspection.

Whether you are a Nunawading homeowner wanting peace of mind or a commercial property manager needing to meet compliance obligations, a thermographic inspection from Millar Electrics is the smartest investment you can make in electrical safety. We service residential and commercial properties across Nunawading, Blackburn, Balwyn, Camberwell, Templestowe and all Melbourne eastern suburbs. Every inspection includes a detailed thermal report with images and prioritised remediation recommendations. Call 0421 237 773 or email david@millarelectrics.com.au to book your thermographic electrical inspection and take the first step toward a safer property today.
